_provenance.producer: OpenSSL 3.6.3 (9 Jun 2026), `openssl mac ... KMAC128|KMAC256` — an implementation independent of the sp800-185 crate this engine uses
_provenance.inputs: Product-authored, pseudo-random from a fixed seed (20261103), chosen to straddle the Keccak rates (KMAC128 168 bytes, KMAC256 136 bytes), the bytepad boundaries, empty and long customization strings, and several output lengths. Byte-aligned only, as the PKCS#11 v3.3 draft restricts KMAC lengths to bytes.
_provenance.evidence_class: independent-oracle (NOT a published NIST vector; NIST's own ACVP sets use bit-oriented lengths that a byte interface cannot express: only 2 of 1,600 cases are byte-aligned and non-XOF, both already in acvp-ws-e/kmac_acvp_test.json)
